pairs.target: dìèrtiān zǎoshàng , tǎ wéi bǎ xiěgěi chí ān de zhǐ zhé guò yícì , yòu tānkāi . zuì shàngtóu nà jù wèn de shì nǚrén zài děng shuí , xiàmiàn jǐngēnzhe yǒuméiyǒu rén lái jiē .
pairs.english: Next morning Tavi folded his letter to Chian once and opened it again. The first question asked whom the woman awaited, immediately followed by whether anyone came for her.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天早上，塔维把写给迟安的纸折过一次，又摊开。最上头那句问的是女人在等谁，下面紧跟着有没有人来接。

pairs.target: liǎngjù dōu xiě dé hěn duǎn , dú qǐlái què xiàng zǎo tì duìfāng xuǎn hǎo le yígè rén , zhī děng tā diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Both were short, yet read as though he'd already chosen someone for the other man to confirm.
pairs.hanzi: 两句都写得很短，读起来却像早替对方选好了一个人，只等他点头。

pairs.target: tā méi jiāng yuán xìn zài chāo yíbiàn , ná chǐ yāzhù zhǐbiān , bǎ zhè liǎngjù huàdiào . chí ān shuō guò , yě kěnéng zhǐshì xiējiǎo , zìjǐ ruò piān tiāo děng rén nà yíbàn qù wèn , xià yìfēng huílái de jiūjìng shì shuí de jìyì , tā biàn gèng shuōbùqīng .
pairs.english: He weighted the paper with his ruler and crossed the questions out instead of recopying. Chian had allowed for simply resting; if Tavi asked only about waiting, whose memory would the next reply contain?
pairs.hanzi: 他没将原信再抄一遍，拿尺压住纸边，把这两句划掉。迟安说过，也可能只是歇脚，自己若偏挑等人那一半去问，下一封回来的究竟是谁的记忆，他便更说不清。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng duān zhōu jìnlái , kànjiàn yìzhuō zhǐ , wèn jīnrì shìfǒu yào lián zhuōzi yě jìzǒu .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng brought porridge, saw the tableful of papers, and asked if the table was being posted too today.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡端粥进来，看见一桌纸，问今日是否要连桌子也寄走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , nuóchū fàng wǎn de dìfāng , jiāng gǎiguò de nà jùdòu gěi tā tīng : ruò hái néng xiǎngqǐ , tóng yuàn ā qiǎo hòulái suí nǎ hù rén zhù , shìfǒu yǒu dāngshí zhàoliào nǐmen de dàrén liúxià míngzì , bú jìde yě qǐng búbì miǎnqiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed, made space for the bowl, and read his revision: if he remembered, which household Aqiao from the same courtyard had later stayed with, and whether any adult carer had left a name. No forcing recollection if he didn't remember.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，挪出放碗的地方，将改过的那句读给他听：若还能想起，同院阿巧后来随哪户人住，是否有当时照料你们的大人留下名字，不记得也请不必勉强。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng tīng wán shuō , zhèhuí xiàng qǐng rén shuō tā zhīdào de shì . suíhòu biàn zuòxià chī , méi jiāng bǐ jiēguò qù tì tā xiěchéng lìngyìfēng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said this sounded like asking what someone knew, then sat to eat without taking the pen to write another letter for him.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡听完说，这回像请人说他知道的事。随后便坐下吃，没将笔接过去替他写成另一封。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài xìn wěi tiān le zìjǐ gāng cóng shuǐbiān huílái , jiàn guò huì huàn dìfāng de wūzi , zuò de huó shì huàtú hé chāo jì , huíxìn búbì jí , děng tā fāngbiàn zàishuō .
pairs.english: Tavi added that he'd returned from water country, seen houses that moved, and worked on maps and notes. No hurry to answer; whenever convenient.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在信尾添了自己刚从水边回来，见过会换地方的屋子，做的活是画图和抄记，回信不必急，等他方便再说。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng guò yào buyào jiǎng zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu zài huòxiāng lǐ bèi zhǎodào de shì , zuìhòu xiān méi fàngjìnqù . búshì bùkěn gàosù chí ān , érshì bùxiǎng bǎ quánbù pàntou yíxià dìgěi yígè gāng huí le xìn de rén .
pairs.english: He considered telling of being found in a cargo carriage as a child, but left it out for now. Not unwilling to tell Chian; he didn't want to hand all his hopes to someone who'd only just replied.
pairs.hanzi: 他想过要不要讲自己小时候在货厢里被找到的事，最后先没放进去。不是不肯告诉迟安，而是不想把全部盼头一下递给一个刚回了信的人。

pairs.target: tā zhī shuō , xièxiè nǐ jìde ā qiǎo de mùxié , nà yíduàn zìjǐ dú le liǎngbiàn .
pairs.english: He only said, thank you for remembering Aqiao's wooden clog; he'd read that passage twice.
pairs.hanzi: 他只说，谢谢你记得阿巧的木鞋，那一段自己读了两遍。

pairs.target: xiě wán gěi chí ān de , tǎ wéi lìng qǔ zhǐ , jiāng huíxìn quánwén chāo gěi nài lěi , kāitóu zhùmíng xuégōng zhuǎn lái , zuórì cái dú dào .
pairs.english: After writing Chian, Tavi copied the whole reply for Nerai, noting that the academy had forwarded it and he'd read it only yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 写完给迟安的，塔维另取纸，将回信全文抄给奈蕾，开头注明学宫转来，昨日才读到。

pairs.target: tā zài shí tīng tīng guò tā pà biérén wàngjì dehuà , rújīn yě gāi zhīdào yǒurén rènzhēn xiě le huílái . liǎngfēngxìn gè zhuāng hǎo , yóu jiǎo yíbìng fù le , jì xiàng bùtóng de zhuǎnjiāo chù .
pairs.english: She'd heard his fear of forgotten memories in Shiting and should know someone had answered carefully. He packed both letters, paid postage, and sent them to different forwarding addresses.
pairs.hanzi: 她在石汀听过他怕别人忘记的话，如今也该知道有人认真写了回来。两封信各装好，邮脚一并付了，寄向不同的转交处。

pairs.target: xiàlóu shí , xià róng zhèng zuòzài ménbiān shì yífù xīn xiédài . jiù de hái fàngzài xī shàng , xīn de lüèkuān xiē , chuān dào zuìhòu yígè kǒng biàn kǎzhù .
pairs.english: Downstairs, Xiarong was trying new shoelaces by the door, the old pair on her knees. The new, slightly wider ones caught at the last eyelet.
pairs.hanzi: 下楼时，夏绒正坐在门边试一副新鞋带。旧的还放在膝上，新的略宽些，穿到最后一个孔便卡住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíngxià , shuō zìjǐ jì de kuāndù nándào háishì dà le . tā méi táitóu , xiān jiāng yìng tóu nà yìdiǎn niǎn biǎn , chóngxīn chuān guòqù , cái bǎ xié wǎng dìshàng yí fàng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if his recorded width was still too large. Without looking up she flattened the stiff tip, threaded it again, and set the shoe down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维停下，说自己记的宽度难道还是大了。她没抬头，先将硬头那一点捻扁，重新穿过去，才把鞋往地上一放。

pairs.target: " dōngxī héyòng , yě búbì měiyíchù dōu zìjǐ cháng hǎo . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Being useful doesn't mean every bit grows into place by itself,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “东西合用，也不必每一处都自己长好。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng xiào , yòu pà tā juéde zìjǐ xiào tā . xià róng què xiān xiào le , bǎ jiù xiédài juàn hǎo , shuō duǎn de hái néng nálái bǎng shōutiáo , bú sòng tā , shěngde tā de zhǐ yuèláiyuè duō .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to laugh but feared she'd feel mocked. Xiarong laughed first, rolling up the old laces for tying receipts, not giving them to him lest his papers multiply further.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想笑，又怕她觉得自己笑她。夏绒却先笑了，把旧鞋带卷好，说短的还能拿来绑收条，不送他，省得他的纸越来越多。

pairs.target: xīn xiédài shì chēxíng zuórì xiàwǔ dàihuí de , qián yǐ fùqīng , méi jiào tā diàn , yě méi duō mǎi dìèrfù .
pairs.english: The transport firm had brought them yesterday afternoon. She'd paid in full, with no advance from him and no extra pair.
pairs.hanzi: 新鞋带是车行昨日下午带回的，钱已付清，没叫他垫，也没多买第二副。

pairs.target: tā xì hǎo jié , cóng dài lǐ náchū yìzhāng xīn dìng de chāishì dān . búshì yuèzǒuyuèyuǎn de lù , shì wǎng tái jǐng yídài měizhōu liǎngrì de gùdìng sòng jiàn , shì zuò yígèyuè .
pairs.english: She tied the knot and produced a new job slip: not farther-flung travel, but two fixed delivery days weekly around Moss Well, on a month's trial.
pairs.hanzi: 她系好结，从袋里拿出一张新订的差事单。不是越走越远的路，是往苔井一带每周两日的固定送件，试做一个月。

pairs.target: yù zhe línshí jíjiàn , lìngyì , bùxǔ duìfāng yìzhāng zhǐ biàn zhànqù zìjǐ qíyú rìzi . tā shuōqǐ jiàqián shí yādī yìdiǎn shēng , dǎo búshì pà tǎ wéi zhīdào , shì diànlǐ lìng yíwèi shāoxìn rén yě zài děng huó .
pairs.english: Extra urgent parcels were separately negotiated, no claiming all her other days with one slip. She lowered her voice about price, not from Tavi, but because another carrier waited for work inside.
pairs.hanzi: 遇着临时急件，另议，不许对方一张纸便占去自己其余日子。她说起价钱时压低一点声，倒不是怕塔维知道，是店里另一位捎信人也在等活。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shìfǒu yǐjīng dìng hǎo , tā shuōdìngle tóu yīyuè , hòumiàn hái kàn gèjiā kěnbukěn xù .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if it was settled. The first month, she said; renewal depended on the clients.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问是否已经定好，她说定了头一月，后面还看各家肯不肯续。

pairs.target: tā běnlái xiǎng shuō nà hěn hǎo , hūrán xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài bái péng yì děng zhōu shí , nài lěi tóngyàng dé xiān wèn shuí héshí kāichuán , biàn gǎi wèn dìyītàng shìbushì míngtiān . " hòutiān . " tā shuō , " míngtiān wǒ háiyǒu míngtiān de . "
pairs.english: He nearly said that was good, then remembered Nerai waiting for porridge at White Awning Station and asking whose boat left when. Instead he asked if the first run was tomorrow. “Day after,” she said. “Tomorrow has tomorrow's work.”
pairs.hanzi:
他本来想说那很好，忽然想起自己在白棚驿等粥时，奈蕾同样得先问谁何时开船，便改问第一趟是不是明天。
“后天。”她说，“明天我还有明天的。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , shuō ruò shì dé hǎo , xiǎng tīng tā huílái jiǎng nǎjiā qiānshōu zuìmàn . xià róng wèn tā shìbushì pàn zhe zìjǐ búshùn , tā shuō búshì , zhǐshì bù zhīdào gāi wèn shénme cái bú xiàng zhī wèn yìzhāng dān shàng xiě hǎo de shì .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded: if the trial went well, he wanted to hear which client signed slowest. Xiarong asked if he wished her trouble. No, he said; he didn't know what to ask beyond the slip's written facts.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，说若试得好，想听她回来讲哪家签收最慢。夏绒问他是不是盼着自己不顺，他说不是，只是不知道该问什么才不像只问一张单上写好的事。

pairs.target: tā kàn le tā yíhuìer , zhǐzhe xié shuō nà jiù xiān wèn chuānzhe zěnmeyàng . tā wèn le , tā biàn zhàn qǐlái zǒu liǎngbù , huídá hǎoduō le , zhìshǎo zhèhuí búbì pà bànlù yòu duàn , bèizhe jiàn hái dé dūnxià xì .
pairs.english: She pointed at her shoes: ask how they felt first. He did; she stood and walked two steps, saying much better, less fear of breaking halfway and crouching to tie them with parcels on her back.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了他一会儿，指着鞋说那就先问穿着怎么样。他问了，她便站起来走两步，回答好多了，至少这回不必怕半路又断，背着件还得蹲下系。

pairs.target: shōuhuò chù yǒurén hǎn tā , tā jiāng chāishì dān sāi huí dài lǐ , yòu bǎ xīn xiédài de jié lèjǐn yíxià , cái pǎo guò jiē .
pairs.english: Someone called her from the receiving office. She stowed the slip, tightened the new lace knot, and ran across the street.
pairs.hanzi: 收货处有人喊她，她将差事单塞回袋里，又把新鞋带的结勒紧一下，才跑过街。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn le yìyǎn zìjǐ shǒulǐ de kōng xìnfēng biān zhǐ , jiāng tā zhé xiǎo , fàngjìn bāo lǐ , suíhòu yě qù shàngbān .
pairs.english: Tavi glanced at the envelope scrap in his hand, folded it small into his bag, and went to work too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看了一眼自己手里的空信封边纸，将它折小，放进包里，随后也去上班。
